title: Allocation of Arriving Stock to Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Reservations
content:
Fulfilment Operations allocates arriving stock to Pre-Orders & Back-Orders reservations under the following rule.

**Rule.** Arriving stock is allocated according to the type's allocation order. For most types, reservations are served in order of reservation time. For a Launch Pre-Order, reservations are ordered first by the launch pre-order allocation priority of the customer's Marlowe Rewards tier on the allocation date, and then by reservation time. Customers without an open membership come after every member. A reservation that is awaiting consent is skipped until it is consented. Where the type cancels unallocated reservations with a full refund when stock falls short, the reservations that the launch stock cannot cover are cancelled for the reason launch shortfall. Otherwise those reservations receive a delay notice. An allocated unit ships within the type's business days from allocation to shipment.

**Order of service**

| Type | First key | Second key |
|---|---|---|
| Launch Pre-Order | Allocation priority of the Marlowe Rewards tier on the allocation date; customers without an open membership last | Reservation time |
| Every other type | Reservation time | — |

**Worked illustration (hypothetical Launch Pre-Order with two units arriving)**

| Reservation | Marlowe Rewards standing on the allocation date | Reserved at | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | Member of a higher-priority tier | 10:05 | Allocated first |
| B | Member of a lower-priority tier | 09:40 (early access) | Allocated second |
| C | No open membership | 10:00 | Not covered: cancelled for launch shortfall, with a full refund |
| D | Member of the higher-priority tier, awaiting consent | 09:50 | Skipped until consented |

For a type that sends delay notices on a shortfall, a reservation in C's position would receive a delay notice instead of being cancelled.
